name: elastic-refresh
title: Elastic Refresh
description: A feed you pull to refresh and swipe to clear: pulling meets rising resistance, a pill stretches with an arrow that flips past 64px and becomes a spinner on release; swiping a row past 90px marks it done, the row folds away and a toast offers Undo
docs: Docs: https://notchset.dev/components/elastic-refresh · Agent prompt: https://notchset.dev/md/elastic-refresh.md · For the full notchset look, also add @notchset/notchset (tokens and fonts). · Needs React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4 (Tailwind 3 projects: upgrade first, see https://notchset.dev/docs/installation).

meta.useWhen: pull to refresh, swipe to dismiss, activity feed, notifications list, swipe actions
